turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of a class, nobody called me, and I want to know who decided that and on what basis.
So the defense is that he just types really fast?

I haven't said a word about typing, and I'm not here to mount a defense; you're the one who has to justify a zero. You still haven't told me who decided or when. If you have something with a date on it, put it in front of me.
182 words in six minutes. Wow. Maybe he should be a court stenographer.
"182 words in six minutes." From what document, on what date, and who else has seen it? And you can keep the jokes about my son to yourself, Hale, because I'm writing that one down.

I'm not your counsel and I don't need a theory; the burden is yours. You've given me a number and two jokes, and no document. Turn the screen around, or I'm going to the principal's office when I walk out of here.
